description: This file defines a fragment class 'LogFragment' that encapsulates a LogView for displaying log messages in an Android application. It manages the creation and configuration of the UI components, including a ScrollView and a custom LogView, and handles text change events to auto-scroll the log view.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a log in a scrollable view, providing methods to initialize and manage the log display.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and returns the view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and a custom LogView with specified layout parameters and styling.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a text change listener on the LogView to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the instance of the LogView used within the fragment.
